description: Schematic cross-section of the Boeing 777X: Stretched twinjet with extra-long composite wing; wingtips shown extended in flight and folded on ground; massive GE9X nacelles, lengthened fuselage, 777-style six-wheel bogies. The ASCII plan below is a labeled schematic (not to construction scale) showing the major zones.
key_points: Zones: nose / flight deck, forward cabin, wing box / main gear, aft cabin, tail / APU
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; engines provide thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.

demo.program:
# JAH Databases demo — record JAH-B777X-000017
# Boeing 777X: Blueprint: cross-section
model = "Boeing 777X"
mtow_kg = 351534
wing_area_m2 = 516.7
derived = mtow_kg / wing_area_m2
print(f"Derived wing loading: {derived:,.1f} kg/m²")  # -> 680.3 kg/m²
print("specs: Length: 76.7 m (777-9); Wingspan: 71.8 m (extended) / 64.8 m (folded); Height: 19.7 m; Maximum takeoff weight: 351,534 kg; Engines: 2 × General Electric GE9X; Typical seating: 426 (two class, 777-9); Range: 13,500 km (77")
print("OK: JAH-B777X-000017 verified")
demo.note: Demonstration recomputes the derived statistic from the record's own numbers.
